verdicts.reason: Both scatter the three fare cards into a disjointed zigzag, put them in reverse order (Reykjavik first, Lisbon last), wedge the subcopy between cards away from the headline, and shrink the city names and 'from' labels until they can't be read. B is worse: the Lisbon card overlaps the Marrakech card, and the Meridian logo mark crowds or overlaps its wordmark. A at least keeps the cards apart and the logo intact.
